content.comment_body: Does anyone know where to find the lost alive feature in the Ethernet connection settings? In [product_name] [version_no], it was available, but in the newer [version_no] it seems to be missing.
This function has been removed starting from [version_no]. For further details, it's best to contact [company_name] support.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is searching for the 'keep alive' or 'lost alive' option that was previously present in the Ethernet settings of [product_name] [version_no], but they report it is missing in the current [version_no]. Another user confirms this feature has been discontinued as of [version_no] and no alternatives are suggested.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to locate and set up the 'keep alive' (lost alive) option in the Ethernet settings of the latest software release as was formerly possible.
